title: The Doctor's condition
notes: Boarding clearance (ACCESS.md 3.5-3.7). After the second rescue, or the lock.
The Doctor's biofilter: a nanoprobe sample off one of the Borg among the dead.
Must not name a Changeling or the weapon's author: this can ring before the
reveal. What is walking around could walk aboard, and that is enough.

lines.text: Shepard. Before you come up, the Doctor has a condition.
It is the Captain's condition. I merely agree with it.
Whatever is walking around down there could walk aboard in you.
So you pass my biofilter first. Any of my stations will do.
The filter has to be calibrated, and for that I need a sample.
Some of the dead are more machine than corpse. Nanoprobes.
Put one down, bring me what it carries, and I will screen you.
And come to me clean. I do not screen a patient mid-cure.
